As the Battle of Falleen begins the events of "Downfall of a Droid," it must occur after the events of "Rookies," which featured the [[defense of Rishi Station]]. |conc= |next=[[Battle of Bothawui]]{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}} |image= |name=Battle of Falleen |conflict=*[[Clone Wars]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|21|Databank A-Z}} **[[Skytop Station campaign]] |date=[[22 BBY]]{{TCWcanondates|106}} As the battle of [[Falleen]] was mentioned to have occurred directly before the events of "Downfall of a Droid," it must have taken place in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] as well. |place=[[Falleen (planet)|Falleen]] |result=*[[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] victory **[[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[Falleen battle group]] lost |side1=Confederacy of Independent Systems |side2=Galactic Republic |side3= |side4= |commanders1=*[[Count]] [[Dooku]]{{EncyclopediaCite|The Separatists}} *[[General]] [[Grievous]] *[[Commander]]''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' [[Asajj Ventress]] |commanders2= |commanders3= |commanders4= |unit1= |unit2= |unit3= |unit4= |forces1=A [[fleet]]''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' |forces2=Falleen [[battle group]]† |forces3= |forces4= |casual1= |casual2=The battle group |casual3= |casual4= |civilian= }} {{Quote|Among our most recent losses was the battle group at Falleen.|Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} During the [[Skytop Station campaign]] of the [[Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Galactic Republic]] engaged in a '''battle''' on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Falleen (planet)|Falleen]]. Led by [[Count]] [[Dooku]], [[General]] [[Grievous]], and [[Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress]], the [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]] emerged victorious, taking over the planet and destroying the Republic's [[Falleen battle group|battle group]] stationed there. ==Prelude== [[Falleen (planet)|Falleen]] was a [[planet]] in the [[Mid Rim Territories]][[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] which, before the [[First Battle of Geonosis|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], joined the latter faction, supplying the Separatists with an advantage in [[The galaxy|galactic]] trade during the [[Separatist Crisis]].[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] However, Falleen later joined the Republic, with a [[Republic Navy]] [[Falleen battle group|battle group]] being stationed there. Despite enduring several serious setbacks in [[22 BBY]], the first year of the war,''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' Separatist [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|leader]] [[General]] [[Grievous]] continued his crusade against the [[Jedi Order]] and the Republic through a [[Skytop Station campaign|new campaign]]. [[File:FirstDate-ROTS.png|thumb|right|270px|After an encounter with the forces of Anakin Skywalker (center), General Grievous (left) led his fleet to Falleen and attacked the previously Confederacy-aligned world.]] The campaign was made possible by intelligence secured through the [[Skytop Station]] [[listening post]].{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}} After a [[Standard month|month]] of invasions and [[blockade]]s, Grievous's campaign had jeopardized the Republic's powerbase in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. His next target was the planet [[Bothawui]], which was important to the Republic's own intelligence operations and foothold in the Mid Rim. While a [[Skywalker's fleet|Republic fleet]] under [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s [[Commanding officer|command]] made its way to Bothawui to defend the planet, Grievous was able to attack the fleet by pulling it from [[hyperspace]]. Although Skywalker's fleet ultimately escaped Grievous's attack and continued on its way to Bothawui, Grievous elected to alter his plans and, instead of chasing Skywalker further, chose to help coordinate attacks against the Republic's forces stationed near Falleen. ==The battle== Assisted by the [[Head of State|leader]] of the Separatist state, [[Count]] [[Dooku]], and his personal [[assassin]], [[Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress]], Grievous led an agile [[fleet]] to attack Falleen as part of his wider campaign. After the battle began on Falleen, the [[Confederacy military|Confederate forces]] under Grievous's command emerged victorious and wiped out the entire Republic [[battle group]], which became one of many losses the Republic sustained during Grievous's campaign. As such, Falleen fell to the Confederacy. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|The Separatist fleet commanded by General Grievous is headed your way.''"
"''Seems like that coward always knows where and when to attack us.|Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker discuss Grievous's advance after the fall of Falleen|}} Due to losses like those on Falleen, the Republic's operations were heavily hampered.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode006.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Downfall of a Droid}} Following the victory on Falleen, the cyborg general and his fleet moved to [[Battle of Bothawui|capture]] Bothawui, where Skywalker was stationed with his task force. Although he was warned about the defeat on Falleen and Grievous's numbers by fellow Jedi General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Skywalker continued his defense, leading to a Republic victory that stopped the Confederacy from furthering its hold on the Mid Rim. While Grievous escaped and his victory on Falleen mitigated his loss at Bothawui, Skytop Station was [[Raid on Skytop Station|destroyed]] a short while later. [[File:Skytop_station_destroyed.png|thumb|left|250px|Shortly after Grievous's victory on Falleen, the listening post that had made his wider campaign possible was destroyed.]] Nonetheless, Grievous's attack on Falleen proved to be one of many attacks launched by the cyborg that disrupted the Republic, with his many victories making it seem like he was an almost indestructible enemy. As Grievous and his fleet continued to attack planets such as the [[Expansion Region]]''[[Star Wars: Aliens of the Galaxy]]'' world of [[Dorin]], the Republic remained unable to estimate where he would strike next, which distracted the regime and enabled formerly pacified worlds to rise up once more, leading to engagements like the [[Second Battle of Geonosis]]. Even though both had served in the battle for Falleen, Grievous and Ventress did not come face-to-face during the operation and only met each other in person during the [[Battle of Kamino]] in [[21 BBY]].{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/arc-troopers-trivia-gallery|text="ARC Troopers" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}} establishes that [[Grievous]] and [[Asajj Ventress]] first met each other face-to-face during the [[Battle of Kamino]], which is dated to [[21 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'', seen in "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Trooperss]]." According to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}, the events of "ARC Troopers" occur after the events of "[[Downfall of a Droid]]" and, therefore, the battle of Falleen. As such, Grievous and Ventress cannot have met face-to-face during the earlier battle. ==Behind the scenes== The battle of Falleen was first mentioned in "[[Downfall of a Droid]]," the sixth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series's [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], which first aired on [[November 7]], [[2008]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the battle was known as the [[Fall of Falleen]], and it first appeared in "[[The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen|The Fall of Falleen]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]]''[[The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen]]'' released on the same day{{SWArchive|url=archives/index.html?c=d6de5d83-4da5-48ab-bf34-75cd3af8fbef&k=&page=9|text=''The Clone Wars'' archives}} that led into "Downfall of a Droid."
